description: Web app that transforms long-form markdown content into platform-optimized formats (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Email, Docs) using AI streaming, with a split-pane CodeMirror editor, export system, and localStorage persistence.

userStories.title: Install core dependencies and configure environment
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all project dependencies installed and environment variables configured so the project has the packages required for AI, editors, and markdown processing.
acceptanceCriteria: Install AI SDK packages: `ai` and `@ai-sdk/anthropic`
Install CodeMirror packages: `@codemirror/view`, `@codemirror/state`, `@codemirror/lang-markdown`, `@codemirror/language`, `@uiw/react-codemirror`
Install markdown packages: `unified`, `remark-parse`, `remark-rehype`, `rehype-stringify`, `rehype-sanitize`
Install utility packages: `lucide-react`
Update `.env.local` to rename `ZAI_API_KEY` to `Z_AI_API_KEY`, `ZAI_BASE_URL` to `Z_AI_BASE_URL`, `ZAI_MODEL` to `Z_AI_MODEL` (keep same values)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: All dependencies installed successfully. Environment variables renamed in .env.local (not committed per .gitignore).

userStories.title: Initialize shadcn/ui with required components

Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: shadcn/ui initialized successfully with all 7 required components. Components verified in components/ui/. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Create project structure, types, and core lib files
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the folder structure, TypeScript interfaces, AI provider config, and system prompts created so all subsequent stories have a foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Create folder structure: `components/editor/`, `components/format/`, `components/settings/`, `components/export/`, `lib/`, `hooks/`, `types/`

Create `types/index.ts` with interfaces: `Format` (union: 'linkedin' | 'twitter' | 'email' | 'docs'), `Tone` (union: 'professional' | 'casual' | 'technical' | 'storytelling'), `RepurposeRequest` (content, format, tone?, customInstructions?), `AppState` (sourceContent, outputs record, settings, lastUpdated)

Create `lib/ai.ts` that exports a configured Anthropic provider using `createAnthropic` with `process.env.Z_AI_BASE_URL` as baseURL and `process.env.Z_AI_API_KEY` as apiKey, and exports the model as `provider(process.env.Z_AI_MODEL || 'glm-4.7')`

Create `lib/prompts.ts` that exports a `getSystemPrompt(format, tone?, customInstructions?)` function returning the correct system prompt string per format (LinkedIn: hook-first 1300 char target with hashtags; Twitter: numbered tweets <=280 chars; Email: subject+preview+greeting+body+CTA; Docs: hierarchical headers+TL;DR+bullets)
Create empty stub files: `lib/metrics.ts`, `lib/storage.ts`, `lib/export.ts` (each exporting nothing, just a comment placeholder)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Clean implementation. All folder structure, types, AI config, and system prompts created successfully. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: AI streaming API route
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a POST /api/repurpose endpoint that validates input and streams AI-generated content back using the Z AI provider.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `app/api/repurpose/route.ts` with a POST handler
Parse JSON body expecting: `content` (string), `format` ('linkedin'|'twitter'|'email'|'docs'), optional `tone`, optional `customInstructions`
Return 400 `{ error: 'Content is required' }` if content is empty or missing
Return 400 `{ error: 'Invalid format' }` if format is not one of the 4 valid values
Import provider and model from `lib/ai.ts`, import `getSystemPrompt` from `lib/prompts.ts`
Call `streamText` from `ai` package with the model, system prompt, and user message `Repurpose the following content:\n\n${content}`
Return `result.toDataStreamResponse()`
Wrap in try/catch, return 500 `{ error: 'AI generation failed' }` on upstream errors
Typecheck passes

acceptanceCriteria: Create `hooks/useRepurpose.ts` that exports a `useRepurpose` hook
Hook uses `useCompletion` from `ai/react` configured to POST to `/api/repurpose`
Hook accepts `format` and returns: `output` (streamed text), `isLoading` (boolean), `error` (string|null), `generate(content, format, tone?, customInstructions?)` function

Hook handles error states and exposes them
